references.help_es: Nivel de potencia referido a 1 W. Para la misma potencia, el nivel en dBm es 30 unidades mayor.

references.help_en: RMS voltage level relative to 1 V. Power requires the load and cannot be inferred from this level alone.
references.help_es: Nivel de tensión eficaz referido a 1 V. La potencia requiere la carga y no se deduce solo de este nivel.

references.formula: 20*log10(V_rms/V_ref); V_ref approximately 0.775 V; historical sqrt(3/5) V convention
references.help_en: RMS voltage level, reference about 0.775 V. Specify the reference convention for precision; dBu alone does not impose a 600 ohm load.
references.help_es: Nivel de tensión eficaz, referencia aprox. 0.775 V. Para precisión, fija la convención; dBu no impone una carga de 600 ohmios.

references.help_en: Sound-pressure level relative to 20 microPa in air. Other media can require another reference.
references.help_es: Nivel de presión sonora referido a 20 microPa en aire. Otros medios pueden requerir otra referencia.

references.help_en: Uses frequency weighting. No universal scalar converts this to an unweighted sound level; the spectrum and time convention matter.
references.help_es: Aplica ponderación frecuencial. No existe factor universal al nivel sin ponderar; importan espectro y convención temporal.

references.formula: level relative to calibrated full-scale reference
references.help_en: Digital level relative to system full scale. Peak/RMS convention and calibration must be stated.
references.help_es: Nivel digital respecto a escala completa del sistema. Deben fijarse convención pico/RMS y calibración.

references.help_en: Speed divided by the local speed of sound. Needs the medium and its state; there is no universal Mach-to-m/s factor.
references.help_es: Velocidad dividida por la velocidad local del sonido. Requiere medio y estado; no hay factor universal a m/s.

references.help_en: Defined from hydrogen-ion activity and a standard state. Do not replace activity by concentration without an applicable model.
references.help_es: Se define por actividad del ion hidrógeno y estado estándar. No sustituyas actividad por concentración sin un modelo válido.

references.formula: pure sucrose mass fraction = Brix/100; mixtures require a refractometric model

references.help_es: En sacarosa pura: gramos de sacarosa por 100 g de disolución. En otras mezclas, el valor aparente depende del método.

references.help_en: Density ratio. State the reference substance and both temperatures; a bare number does not determine density.

references.help_en: Substance- and assay-specific biological activity. No universal conversion to grams or moles; distinct from the enzyme unit U.

references.help_en: Method-specific turbidity. Keep illumination, geometry and calibration; NTU and FNU need not agree for real samples.

extension_notes: All310 requested rows section1+3 mapped; section1g0/e map to separate references.
Symbols withUS/Imp/qualification are UI disambiguators, not claims of standardized printed symbols.
Historical and rounded reference factors remain visibly nonexact; no dimensional arithmetic is activated.
SI seven-dimensional basis is supplemented by quantity/domain metadata for information/counts.
Metric-compatible compound prefixes target one identified component; they do not scale every component.
L/100km requires explicit exact coefficient1/100 in the typed preset.
UCUM2.2 phot and astronomy values intentionally rejected in favor of NIST/IAU/BIPM.
All typed references remain blocked from CAS evaluation in this phase. No free variables or arbitrary CAS strings.
dimension=null means that SI dimensional exponents alone do not describe this contextual quantity; do not treat it as dimension-one scalar.
Published CODATA decimal values are not exact factors. Keep uncertainty and provenance; correlations require policy before derived arithmetic.
Planck force and energy SI values are computed from h,c,G; their numerical uncertainty is first-order propagated from G only.
context-only rows remain insertable identities but need an explicit external system/standard before numerical conversion. No numeric table has been claimed verified for SWG or mesh.
Fixed-scale percent/per-mille/ppm retain ratio meaning and do not reuse the calculator arithmetic percentage operator.
Aliases are query names. Unicode or case-sensitive symbol aliases must not normalize globally or bind variables.
prefixes=[0] for physical constants is deliberate; a prefixed constant is not an SI unit. Standard-gravity milli variant is an explicitly identified fraction.
Equivalent, osmole and international biological unit support decimal multiples as context-preserving references (mEq, mOsm, kIU, etc.), without enabling conversion to mol or mass.
